πλάζομαι: πλάζω — drive astray; pass. wander, be driven about; pres. 1 sg. pass.

προὐφαίνετο: προφαίνω — show forth; pass. appear, become visible; impf. 3 sg. pass., crasis of προ-εφαίνετο

ψαμάθῳ: ψάμαθος — sand, sandy shore; fem. dat. sg.
ἀθρόα: ἀθρόος — crowded together, all together; neut. acc. pl.

ἀμφικαλύψαι: ἀμφικαλύπτω — enfold, cover all round; aor. inf., in a proposal: ’to cover’
ἀπήγαγον: ἀπάγω — lead away, carry off; aor. 3 pl., augmented
ἀπειλάων: ἀπειλή — threat; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
ἀπεών: ἄπειμι — be away, be absent; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπών)

ἀστοί: ἀστός — townsman, fellow citizen; masc. nom. pl.
ἀτιμάζουσι: ἀτιμάζω — dishonour, slight; pres. 3 pl. (= Attic ἀτιμάζουσιν), + acc.

ἀτραπιτοί: ἀτραπιτός — path, track; fem. nom. pl.
ἁμάρτῃ: ἁμαρτάνω — miss, err, do wrong; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause without κε: ’whoever errs’
ἄξειν: ἄγω — lead, bring; fut. inf., after ἔφαντο: ’(said they) would bring’

ἐλεήσῃ: ἐλεέω — pity, have mercy; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a condition after αἴ κε: ’if he take pity’
ἐννοσίγαι: ἐννοσίγαιος — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon; masc. voc. sg., elided (ἐννοσίγαι’ = ἐννοσίγαιε)

ἐξικόμην: ἐξικνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. 1 sg., with κε, unreal past: ’I should have reached’

ἔσομαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 1 sg., middle form

ἠλίβατοι: ἠλίβατος — steep, towering (sense uncertain; ’steep’ is the traditional guess); adj., fem. nom. pl.
ἠπείρῳ: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land, shore; fem. dat. sg.
ἰάλλειν: ἰάλλω — send, hurl, let loose; pres. inf.: ’to assail, to heap upon’ (+ dat. of the thing, ἀτιμίῃσιν ’with dishonours’)

ἴκελον: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὅμοιος)
ὀδυσῆϊ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., epic Ὀδυσῆϊ (single σ, diaeresis; = Ὀδυσσῆϊ, Attic Ὀδυσσεῖ)
ὀπίζομαι: ὀπίζομαι — fear, hold in awe, shrink from; pres. 1 sg. mid., + acc.
ὁδιτάων: ὁδίτης — wayfarer, traveller; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
ὁδοῦ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. gen. sg.: ’the road’ (ἐκτὸς ὁδοῦ ’off the road’)
ὑπέσχεο: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise, undertake; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= ὑπέσχου)
ὑπερβασίην: ὑπερβασίη — overstepping, transgression, outrage; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -η (= Attic -α)
ὑπερμενέων: ὑπερμενής — of exceeding might, overweening; masc. gen. pl., epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν)

ῥήγεϊ: ῥῆγος — rug, blanket; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ῥήγει)

__broaden__.βάντες: βαίνω — go, step; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., root aorist, tmesis ἀνά … βάντες = ἀναβάντες ’having embarked’  ·  also plain, + ἐς and acc. of place entered: ’having stepped into (the tubs)’ · also with ἐκ + gen., no tmesis: ’having stepped out of (the ship)’
__broaden__.τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ‘them, those’ (referring to ships) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the mules · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cattle · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the fruits · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the nymphs and of the Sirens · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: fem. acc. pl. ’which’ (ἀπειλάων, τὰς … ἐπηπείλησε ’threats which he threatened’)
__broaden__.ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε · also ’as, however’ + subj. in a general clause: ὅπως ἐθέλῃσιν ’however he wishes’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might follow’ (ὅπως … ἑποίατο) · also + pres. indic., ’as, in whatever way’ (ὅπως ἐθέλεις ’as you wish’)
__broaden__.κελαινεφές: κελαινεφής — dark with cloud, black as a cloud; adj., neut. nom. sg., said of blood · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), agreeing with αἷμα as object: ’dark-clouded (blood)’ · also masc. voc. sg., address to Zeus: ’dark-clouded one’
__broaden__.πομπῆς: πομπή — sending, escort, conveyance; fem. gen. sg., + gen. with τυγχάνω · also gen. governed by περί: ’about a conveyance’ · also gen. governed by εἵνεκα: ’on account of an escort’ · also gen. governed by ἐκ: ’from an escort’ · also gen. of separation after ἀπολλήγω and παύομαι: ’cease from escorting’
__broaden__.ἔμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic, shortened (= Attic εἶναι; cf. ἔμμεναι) · also μένω — stay, wait; impf. 3 sg., elided, augmented (ἔμεν’ = ἔμενε): ’he waited’
__broaden__.ἀμφικαλύψῃ: ἀμφικαλύπτω — enfold, cover all round; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἐπήν · also aor. subj. 3 sg., after μηδ’, continuing a condition or wish: ’and may he not cover’
__broaden__.χεῦε: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., here in tmesis (ἐπὶ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε): ‘poured upon’ · also in tmesis with περί (περὶ … χεῦε = περίχευε ’poured round’)
__broaden__.μεῖναι: μένω — stay, wait; aor. inf., standing as an instruction: ’wait’ · also infinitive after χρεώ, ’to wait’ (οὐ χρεὼ … ἀλλ’ … μεῖναι ’no need … but to wait’) · also aor. inf. after ὄφελον, an unfulfillable wish: ’would that I had stayed’
__broaden__.γένηται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’shall come’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a direct question of doubt/deliberation, no ἄν/κε: τί … γένηται; ’what is to happen?’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., prospective in a negative statement with a relative clause: οὐδὲ γένηται ’nor ever shall there be’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a general relative clause without ἄν/κε: ’whatever shall come to pass’ (ὅσσα γένηται) · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it become’ (μή … ἕλωρ … γένηται ’lest it become prey’)
__broaden__.πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
__broaden__.ἔφαντο: φημί — say; mid. ’think, suppose, believe’; impf. mid. 3 pl.: ’they supposed’ · also mid. ’said, declared, promised’, + fut. inf. (ἔφαντο ἄξειν ’they said they would bring’)
__broaden__.σφέας: σφεῖς — they; pron., masc. acc. pl., epic σφέας (= Attic σφᾶς), governed by διά: ’through them’ · also acc. pl. object of a verb of teaching: ’them’ (σφέας … ἐδίδαξε ’taught them’) · also acc. pl. reflexive object, with αὐτούς: ’themselves’ (πυκάζοιεν σφέας αὐτούς) · also acc. pl. direct object: ’them’ (Ζεὺς σφέας τίσαιτο ’may Zeus punish them’)
__broaden__.βίῃ: βίη — strength, force; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’by force’ · also dat. sg. with εἴκων, the thing yielded to: ’yielding to force’ (βίῃ καὶ κάρτεϊ εἴκων)
__broaden__.λίνῳ: λίνον — flax, linen thread; neut. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with thread’ · also linen cloth, a sheet; dat. sg. after σύν: ’together with the linen cloth’
__broaden__.τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’ · also in ἦ τέ, a strengthened affirmation: ’truly’ (ἦ τέ μ’ ἔφαντο ’who truly said’)
